compartment.title: Fixed resource transfer bottleneck by increasing maxPerRun

compartments.compartment: Provided console command to manually cancel blocked transfer tasks, which successfully reduced blocked tasks from 31 to 1. Investigated why E7N58 still held unwanted resources (K=4858, Z=500) despite hub:import tasks existing. Found maxPerRun=1 in resourceControl execution meant 53 hub:import tasks would take at least 53 ticks to process, with higher-priority tasks (energy balancing, synthesis routes) blocking them. Increased maxPerRun from 1 to 5 in both live config and code defaults, enabling hub:import tasks to complete in ~11 ticks. U: 提高maxPerRun到5 Set maxPerRun to 5 in code and verified via live console, then pushed to Screeps.

compartment.title: Refactored hub panel to show logistics with progress

compartments.compartment: Refactored hub panel to remove Hub Production section and simplify Logistics display. Initial implementation removed Progress section entirely and showed per-room unique resource type counts. After user feedback, restored Progress section with production progress bars and changed resource display to total remaining amount instead of unique type count. Limited room display to top 3 by task count. Updated tests to match new structure. U: hub面板也需要更新一下了, logistics只显示总任务数量, 以及每个房间的物流任务数量和在物流任务中的资源数量即可 U: 我说的是资源的数量, 不是资源类型的数量 U: 还有, 生产进度也需要保留 U: 房间数只显示任务最多的三个房间 Fixed logistics display to show total task count plus per-room task count and total resource amount, kept progress bars, and capped room display at 3. Updated all tests and pushed.

compartment.title: Implemented auto-sell for hub surplus T3 resources

compartments.compartment: Implemented automatic market selling of hub surplus non-energy/power resources at best buy price. Explored hub planner surplus/reclaim logic and market ops architecture. Added `computeAndStoreMarketSellSurplus` in hubPlanner to calculate T3 surplus above chainTarget and other resources above 5000, storing in `Memory.runtime.hub.marketSellSurplus`. Modified `isHubProtectedResource` to skip surplus resources. Added independent hub surplus sell pass in `applyMarketOps` that bypasses room state checks. Fixed terminal fee calculation to use full terminal energy instead of reserving 20k. Updated global.d.ts types. U: 还有, 对于t3储备生产链外溢出的非energy和power资源, 可以出售给市场最高价的买单 U: 出售不看房间状态 U: 实际那20k energy都是预留的路费 U: 不是只有超过20k的部分才算路费 U: termianl内的energy都是路费 Implemented hub surplus sell with room-state-independent pass and full terminal energy available for fees.

facts.CONSTRAINTS: - Hub surplus sell uses full terminal energy for fees, not just above 20k reserve - Hub surplus sell bypasses room state checks (survival/balanced/export) - Hub surplus resources include T3 compounds above chainTarget and other resources above 5000 threshold - isHubProtectedResource skips resources marked in marketSellSurplus - Hub logistics panel shows total task count and top 3 rooms by task count with total resource amounts - resourceControl task execution uses maxPerRun=5 to process transfer tasks
facts.ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS: - Hub panel shows Progress section with production progress bars and Logistics section with task counts - Hub surplus sell runs as independent pass in applyMarketOps, separate from normal export room sells - hubPlanner stores marketSellSurplus after runHubPlanner completes for use by resourceControl
facts.CONFIG_DEFAULTS: - maxPerRun=5 for resourceControl transfer task execution - terminalEnergyReserve=20k for fee calculations (but hub surplus sell bypasses this)
